items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: This guy called him over, you know, and he said, "I'd like you to meet the guy that has the trio here; he says he went to Gonzaga, too."

ctx.x: I have no idea. [VINCE LOMBARDI/GREEN BAY PACKERS]

Anyway, he was a backfield coach. So the owner of the club said... They were out... They had decided to celebrate at that club that night; they had won the Super Bowl. And they all came out there, see, and he was there. And I told the boss, you know; I said, "I went to school with that guy, Canadeo." I didn't know him, but I went to school with him. Boy, he was snotty. This guy called him over, you know, and he said, "I'd like you to meet the guy that has the trio here; he says he went to Gonzaga, too." And…
What was the name of that team?
